name: Stalk With The Earthmother
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: I sense in you a hidden talent for the subtle arts, champion. Use this mask to infiltrate the nearby Venture Company mine and steal their supplies. It may not seem like a convincing disguise, but a skilled rogue can slip past any guard with naught but a winning smile and a cunning distraction. I believe this capability lies within you as well.
narrative.objectives: Sneak into the Venture Company mine southeast of Thunder Bluff and collect 5 Seaforium Mining Charges from carts of blasting supplies, then return them to Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.
narrative.offerRewardText: Hmm... perhaps disguises are not your strength.
narrative.requestItemsText: We'll need to work on your stealth skills, champion.  I heard you approaching as soon as you set foot on the mesa.
